profile.visual_desc: Muscular human knight in dark blue plate armor with a long flowing royal blue cape. Mounted on a dark-blue horse with grey ornamental padding. Features spiky blue hair and a grey headband.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Dramatic left-facing profile. Features sharp facial lines, intense dark eyes, and a confident smirk under spiky blue hair and a grey headband.
profile.weapon_desc: Long silver-bladed halberd held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Rear-isometric view facing up-left. Ares sits stationary on his horse, holding the halberd horizontally behind his head.
profile.step2_windup: The horse rears up on hind legs while Ares raises the halberd high into a vertical overhead position, preparing a downward strike.
profile.step3_impact: Ares brings the halberd down forcefully. A massive, bright yellow energy crescent curves from the top-left downward, illustrating the weapon's reach.
profile.step4_finish: The horse lands on all four legs. Ares holds the weapon low in a follow-through pose as the cape billows and the golden trail fades.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The golden energy arc accurately tracks the downward vertical swing of the halberd from its peak height to the impact point.

evaluation.diagnosis: The sequence follows the rearing windup and perspective of the reference. VFX duration and alignment in the strike frames show minor timing discrepancies.
